args.body: Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean introduction and having your email right there makes it easy for visitors to reach you. My feedback: since the site is quite brief, it would be even stronger if you added a few more sections — for example, a short bio/about paragraph, highlights of your work or projects, and links to your professional profiles or portfolio. Overall, a solid starting point that would benefit from a bit more personality and substance.

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). It's a great start, and I love that you share your passion for hiking with readers. My feedback: right now the site reads more like an introduction than a blog, so adding actual posts would make it much more engaging. I'd suggest a few themed posts about your hiking adventures — trail guides, gear tips, or photos and stories from your trips — along with an 'About' section and maybe a way for readers to subscribe for updates. Overall, a promising concept that could really shine with more content and visual storytelling.
